features.quote: Budgets. `max_turns` (per task, capped by `global_max_turns`) and a wall-clock `run_timeout_s`
features.justification_quote: bounded budgets make runs comparable and cheap

features.quote: The only commands we intercept are genuinely dangerous ones (network/destructive)
we inject one corrective user message rather than aborting
features.justification_quote: a single nudge recovers the run without masking a genuine refusal to act

features.quote: `stopped_voluntarily` is recorded distinctly from hitting the turn cap
features.justification_quote: the metric must not conflate them
